{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Compute the mean of biomarker_baseline
mean_baseline = df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print all required evidence
print(f"Number of rows excluded due to biomarker_baseline == -999: {df.shape[0] - df_clean.shape[0]}")
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {df_dedup.shape[0]}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline}")"}
